function retainNull<K extends 'x' | 'y'>(key: K, obj: Partial<Record<K, string | null>>) {
  const {[key]: value = 'fallback'} = obj;
  return value.toUpperCase();
}
function canDefaultToUndefined<K extends 'x' | 'y'>(key: K, obj: Partial<Record<K, number>>, fallback: number | undefined) {
  const {[key]: value = fallback} = obj;
  return value.toFixed();
}
function assigned<K extends 'x' | 'y'>(key: K, obj: Partial<Record<K, number>>) {
  let value: number;
  ({[key]: value = 3} = obj);
  return value.toFixed();
}
function mismatch<T extends string | undefined>([value = 1]: [T]) {
  return value;
}
function nonNullable<T extends number>([value = 1]: [T]) {
  return value;
}
function genericIdentity<T extends number | undefined>([value = 1]: [T]): T {
  return value;
}
function fallbackStillGeneric<T extends number | undefined>(fallback: number | undefined, [value = fallback]: [T]) {
  return value;
}
